plan.notes: Source: official College of Southern Idaho 2024-2025 catalog, 'Computer Science, Associate of Science' program page (Major Code: 1701S), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02 from https://csi.smartcatalogiq.com/en/2024-2025/catalog/engineering-physical-and-computer-sciences-department/computer-science/computer-science-associate-of-science . Transcription method: fetched the official program page and transcribed the four 'Fall/Spring Semester Freshman/Sophomore Year' tables verbatim (course codes, titles, credits, printed semester totals). TRUE award: Associate of Science. Total credits: 62, the catalog's published total ('Total Credit Hours: 62'); semester totals 16/16/16/14 sum exactly. Zero-credit corequisite labs (COMS 229L, COMS 250L, and the PHYS 211L/CHEM 111L lab) are required 0-credit courses, modeled with required_zero=true per validator convention. Choice slots: SCIG GE / HUMA GE / HUMA GE2 / SOCS GE / SOCS GE2 / WELL are official catalog placeholders for 'any Gen. Ed.' course in that category (student choice); PROG ELEC rows are 'Program Electives' (3 credits each semester; student choice from the program-electives list printed on the page: COMS 260, BUSA 207, ENGL 202, MATH 230, MATH 275, MATH 310, COMS 253). Spring Sophomore science: official 'PHYS 211 Physics Scientists & Engineers 1* (5) + PHYS 211L lab* (0) OR CHEM 111 General Chemistry I* (5) + CHEM 111L lab* (0)' - modeled as one 5-credit choice slot plus a required 0-credit lab slot. Prereqs: left empty. The catalog marks courses with '*' as 'Prerequisite or corequisite required' but does not name the prerequisite on the plan page; per-course prerequisites live on the official catalog course pages. Footnotes: Science/Social Science/Humanities courses must each be from 2 different disciplines. The catalog notes 'Alternative plans of study available by contacting your advisor.'
